provenance.runs: the four arxiv_mutation_ubfilter_*.json files each carry the provenance of their run (x86_64 box, Docker, harness/arxiv_mutub_run.sh); results/arxiv_mutation_ubfilter_vert.json carries the provenance of the VERT runs (arm64 Mac and x86_64 box, Docker, crust-vert-toolchain[-x86])

kill_rule: a mutant is killed if OUR harness, on OUR inputs, reports a wrong answer (value, stdout, exit code or output file) or a crash; not counted: stderr-only differences, hangs/timeouts, kills by the system's own test; and (UB rule) a kill counts only on an input where the C is UB-clean under the rule the defect count uses

label_marks.*: lower bound: `undetermined` mutants are not counted as killed
label_marks.\u2020: upper bound: the per-mutant record cannot separate stderr-only and timeout kills (rule_separable false)
